verdict.rationale: Community reports show TeamViewer used to reach a machine with no one at the host: one user logs into Windows on a PC after Wake-on-LAN. Other reports discuss client-side saved passwords that the client replays, which implies credentials configured in advance. First-party evidence is only adjacent: managed devices assigned to a company account and MSI mass deployment, with no explicit unattended-access documentation. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the unattended-access setup (preset password or account assignment without host acceptance), admin-side configuration details, and independent corroboration beyond anecdotal comments.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept

citations.quote: One user runs TeamViewer on a single PC only to log into Windows and start Steam (via VPN and Wake-on-LAN) before using Steam Remote Play.
